detail: Paradromics partnered with NVIDIA to integrate high-performance AI computing into brain-computer interfaces to target thought-to-speech latency under 10 milliseconds.
why_relevant: Combines brain-computer interfaces with low-latency AI signal processing, directly fitting biosignal-ML and neuroengineering backgrounds.

detail: Exicure signed an agreement to acquire between 20% and 100% of NeuroQ Biologics and provide up to $500,000 to advance the X-CUE AR smart glasses for Parkinson's freezing of gait.
why_relevant: Focuses on wearable AR technology aimed at treating motor symptoms in Parkinson's disease, highly applicable to neuromodulation and movement disorder research.

detail: Neumic Therapeutics is seeking $1 million in pre-seed investment funding to advance its brain-tech technologies.
why_relevant: An early-stage brain-tech startup offering opportunities in novel neuromodulation and neurotechnology research.

detail: Vire Health launched the Vire Clip waist-worn wearable backed by Oura co-founders and initiated a testing program ahead of a planned 2027 commercial rollout.
why_relevant: Focuses on continuous biosignal monitoring including body temperature, respiration, and heart rate from wearable sensors.

detail: Multiwave received FDA clearance for its portable brain MRI imaging device.
why_relevant: Develops novel portable neuroimaging hardware suitable for BME students interested in brain mapping and neurodiagnostic instrumentation.
